name: skiphow
description: Autonomous project work for nontechnical product owners.

interface.shortDescription: Project work from one owner request
interface.longDescription: Start from one plain-language owner request. SkipHow selects only the focused internal guidance that helps; technical decisions, authorized completion, and verification stay with the agent.
defaultPrompt: Here are today's bugs and ideas. Organize and save them so we can prioritize tomorrow.
Fix the problems reported today and finish everything that is safe to finish locally.
The totals overlap on small screens. Find the cause and fix it.
